<|det|>title [27, 64, 316, 104]<|/det|>WATER QUALITY FIELD REPORT
<|det|>text [27, 118, 636, 163]<|/det|>Station: Willow Creek East Survey: WC-1186 Date: 28 September 2026
<|det|>text [27, 228, 636, 272]<|/det|>The morning survey covered the upstream bridge and the southern footpath.
<|det|>text [27, 282, 607, 325]<|/det|>Three sealed samples were collected before the first scheduled discharge.
<|det|>text [27, 338, 588, 382]<|/det|>Sample A: 08:15, temperature 18.4 C, pH 7.2, conductivity 412 uS/cm.
<|det|>text [27, 392, 591, 435]<|/det|>Sample B: 08:27, temperature 18.6 C, pH 7.1, conductivity 409 uS/cm.
<|det|>text [27, 447, 591, 491]<|/det|>Sample C: 08:42, temperature 18.5 C, pH 7.3, conductivity 415 uS/cm.
<|det|>text [27, 554, 654, 598]<|/det|>No visible surface film was observed. The water appeared clear at all locations.
<|det|>text [27, 609, 675, 653]<|/det|>Each sample bottle was labelled, photographed, and placed in the transport case.
<|det|>text [27, 664, 664, 707]<|/det|>Laboratory results are pending; these observations are not a safety certification.
<|det|>text [27, 774, 562, 818]<|/det|>Prepared by: Field Operations Reviewed by: Laboratory Services
